exact_statement: For every nonconstant monotone Boolean sign core g on s>=1 uniform bits and 0<delta<=1, choose h=g or h(z)=-g(-z) with false density q<=1/2, fix ANY finite positive CNF for h with nonempty anchors, and repeat each anchor with L=2s+2ceil(log2(16/delta)) distinct positive private bits to obtain A015 F_L. Every fixed subprobability nonempty reference R covering F_L and satisfying complete C(F_L;R)<=K I(F_L), K>=0, induces a normalized nonempty core reference r with C_g(r)<=(1+delta)K I(g). Specifically epsilon=2^-L, rho=2^s qepsilon<1, a=(1-rho)^2, u_S=Fhat_L(S,empty)^2>=a p_S for p_S=ghat(S)^2, E=all nonempty core sets, Z=sum_E R, D=sum_E u log2(1/R), and B=sum_E(u-ap)log2(1/R)>=0 give the EXACT C_g(r)=(D-B)/a+Var(g)log2 Z. For ANY raw successful reference Q with total mass<=theta=Pr(initial roots nonempty)>0 and R=Q/theta, the TWO normalizers cancel exactly: C_g(r)=(D_Q-B_Q)/a+Var(g)log2 Q_E, Q_E=sum_E Q>0. This retains rare-sector surprisal and surplus for all 0<Q_E<=theta<=1. It refunds one nested conditioning event, not repeated-root/label/attachment costs. No common amplitude scaling, universal source, free adaptive reset, empty/nonempty wrapper absorption or full FEI solution is asserted.
